_about: Meridian Motors Design & Engineering Guidelines MY2027 (fictional, illustrative). This is the RAG corpus for Module 3. 'check' blocks are only used by the offline mock judge; the real LLM judge reads 'text'.

guidelines.title: Approved body colour palette
guidelines.text: Production body colours must be selected from the MY2027 approved palette (status 'approved' in the colour catalogue). Limited-edition colours (status 'limited_edition') may be used only for run sizes under 2,000 units and require Brand Council approval. Concept-only colours are not permitted for production.

guidelines.title: Fluorescent and neon finishes
guidelines.text: Fluorescent, neon or day-glo finishes fail UV durability requirements (ISO 16474-2, 2,000 h) and are prohibited on exterior painted panels. They may appear only on concept and show cars.

guidelines.title: Two-tone doors
guidelines.text: Doors must match the body colour. A contrast door or roof colour (two-tone) is permitted only using Obsidian Black (OB-900) or Lunar Silver (LS-450) and only on Sport and GT trims. Any other contrasting door colour requires a design deviation request.

guidelines.title: Mirror cap finishes
guidelines.text: Exterior mirror caps may be body colour, gloss black (MR-GB), Lunar Silver (MR-SILVER) or carbon fibre (MR-CARBON, GT trim only). Custom-painted mirror caps in any other colour are non-standard and not supported by the mirror supplier.

guidelines.title: Bonnet design and pedestrian protection
guidelines.text: All bonnet designs must preserve a minimum 75 mm deformation clearance between the bonnet skin and hard engine-bay points to meet UN R127 pedestrian head-impact requirements. Flat, power-dome, vented and striped bonnets are released for all trims.

guidelines.title: Bonnet scoops
guidelines.text: A functional bonnet scoop (BN-SCOOP) is restricted to performance (GT) trims because it requires the active pop-up bonnet actuator (AH-01) to retain UN R127 compliance. Selecting a scoop on non-GT trims requires engineering review.

guidelines.title: Wheel and tyre fitment
guidelines.text: Released wheel sizes are 16 to 20 inch. 5-spoke, multi-spoke and turbine aero wheels are released for saloon, hatchback and coupe bodies. Steel wheels are fleet-only.

guidelines.title: All-terrain wheels
guidelines.text: All-terrain wheels and chunky tyres (WH-AT-18) are released only for SUV and pickup bodies because they change ride height and wheel-arch clearance. On any other body style they are not permitted.

guidelines.title: Paint test requirement
guidelines.text: Every production body colour requires a released paint test specification covering colour match (CIELAB Delta E against master panel), gloss, dry film thickness, adhesion, corrosion (neutral salt spray) and accelerated weathering before PPAP sign-off.

guidelines.title: Brand character
guidelines.text: Meridian Motors design language favours clean surfaces, a strong shoulder line and no more than three exterior colours on a single vehicle (body, contrast and trim).

guidelines.title: Chrome reduction
guidelines.text: Bright chrome trim is being phased out from MY2027 in favour of satin silver or gloss black accents to reduce hexavalent chromium usage in the supply chain.

guidelines.title: Sketch submission quality
guidelines.text: Design sketches submitted to the review board should show a full side profile, clearly coloured body and doors, visible mirrors, bonnet detailing and wheels. Sketches missing two or more of these elements are returned to the designer.
